excerpt.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
excerpt.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.
